notes: Fully self-contained script: inline datalines build sample_adsl, then a %count macro select-into's per-treatment-group subject counts via PROC SQL. No edits needed to run. Confirmed a Jenner engine bug during self-check (filed as set/ regression test 404162, PR EastAgile/jenner-language#14968): the %put lines inside the %do loop print the literal unresolved &bign<i> token instead of the value, because the macro-body %do-loop-body expansion doesn't interleave PROC SQL INTO writes with same-iteration %put the way SAS requires. The underlying computation is unaffected (verified correct via the NOTE: Macro variable BIGNx = value log lines), so expected.json pins on those NOTE lines rather than the buggy %put output.
